title: Design, eco-friendly synthesis, and molecular docking studies of isatin hybrids as promising therapeutic agents (anticancer, anticholinesterase inhibitor, α-glucosidase inhibitor, and anti-MRSA)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32309-32327
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04722F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Israa A. Seliem
Green synthesis of isatin-coumarin hybrid produced multifunctional candidate that showed α-glucosidase and cholinesterase inhibition. They also exhibited anti-MRSA activity, anticancer effects on breast cancer cells and strong protein binding.
